identificationModule.briefTitle: Nexavar-Tarceva Combination Therapy for First Line Treatment of Patients Diagnosed With Hepatocellular Carcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III Randomized, Placebo Controlled, Double Blind Trial of Sorafenib Plus Erlotinib vs. Sorafenib Plus Placebo as First Line Systemic Treatment for Hepatocellular Carcinoma (HCC)

armGroups.label: Sorafenib (Nexavar, BAY43-9006) + Erlotinib (Tarceva)
armGroups.description: Participants received sorafenib 400 mg twice daily (bid) and erlotinib 150 mg tablet once daily (qd)

armGroups.label: Sorafenib (Nexavar, BAY43-9006) + Placebo
armGroups.description: Participants received sorafenib 400 mg twice daily (bid) and matching erlotinib placebo 150 mg tablet once daily (qd)

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Matching erlotinib placebo 150 mg once daily
